a: आंभस — a. (सी f.) [अंभस्-अण्] Watery, fluid.
आंभसिक — a. (की f.) [अंभसा वर्तते ठक्] Aquatic. --कः A fish.

आंछ् — {c1c} P. (आंछति, आनंछ, आंछित) 1 To lengthen, stretch, extend. --2 To make straight. --3 To regulate, bring or draw into the right position; set (as a bone or leg.); चक्रयोगेनांछेदूर्वस्थि निर्गतं Suśr.
आंछनं — Setting(a bone or leg); bringing into the right position by stretching, bending, or drawing.
आंधसः — The scum of boiled rice.
आंधसिकः — [अंधो भक्तं शिल्पमस्य ठक्] A cook.
आंध्र — a. Belonging to Andhra(as language). --ध्रः (pl.) The Telagu country, modern Telangaṇa; see अंध्र.
आंध्यं — [अंधस्य भावः ष्यञ्] Blindness.

m: आंश m. a descendant of Aṃśa Comm. on Uṇ. v, 21.
आंश्य mfn. relating to अंश (q.v.), (g. संकाशादि, q.v.)

a: आंबरीषपुत्रकः — A country inhabited by the Ambarīṣaputras.
आंबष्ठः — An inhabitant of Ambaṣṭha.
आंबिकेयः — [अंबिकाया अपत्यं ढक्] An epithet of (a) Dhṛtarāṣṭra; (b) Kārtikeya.
आंचनं — Partial extraction of thorns, arrows and the like from the body.
आंदोल् — {c10c} P. [--दोलयति, दोलित] 1 To swing, rock or move to and fro. --2 To shake, tremble (fig. also); Māl. 4; मंदमारुतांदोलिता लतेव Dk. 17, 21.
आंदोलः — 1 Swinging, a swing. --2 Trembling.
आंदोलनं — [आंदोल् भावे ल्युट्] 1 Swinging, a swing. --2 Moving to and fro, shaking, rocking; किंत्वासामरविंदसुंदरदृशां द्राक्चामरांदोलनात् Udb. --3 Trembling, oscillation.
आंगारं — [अंगाराणां समूहः अण्] A multitude of fire-brands, charcoal.
आंगूषः — [अंगूष-स्वार्थे-अण्] Praise, hymn.

आंग — a. (गी f.) [अंग-स्वार्थे-अण्] 1 Bodily, corporeal. --2 (In gram.) Relating to the base (अंग). --3 Having limbs or parts. --4 Relating to the minor personages in a drama. --5 Belonging to a portion of the Vedas. --6 Produced or born in the country of the Aṅgas. --गः A prince of the Aṅga country. --गं A delicate body.
आंगक — a. (की f.) [अंगेषु जनपदेषु भवः वुञ्] Produced in the अंग country; ruler of that country. --कः 1 An inhabitant of the Aṅga country. --2 A ruler of that country.
आंगविद्य — a. [अंगविद्यां वेद अण्] Occurring in, or being familiar with, अंगविद्या (chiromancy or the knowledge of lucky and unlucky marks on the body). --द्या A work on अंगविद्या.
आंगिक — a. (की f.) [अंगनिर्वृत्तार्थे-ठक्] 1 Bodily, corporeal. --2 Gesticulated, expressed by bodily actions; आंगिकोऽभिनयः, see अभिनय. --कः A player on a tabor or drum.

आंगिरस — a. (सी f.) Descended from or referring to Aṅgiras. --सः 1 N. of Bṛhaspati, son of Aṅgiras; Ms. 2. 151. --2 Descendants of Angiras (pl.). --3 A particular Sūkta or hymn in the Atharvaveda. --4 The soul. --5 A Kṣatriya by will of Brahmā and by profession.

m: आंहस्पत्य mfn. belonging to the dominion of Aṃhaspati (as the intercalary month), Gobh.

a: आंजलिक्यं — [cf. आंजनिक्यं] Folding the hands in supplication.
आंजनी — Ointment, especially for the eyes. --Comp. --कारी a woman who anoints or prepares ointments.
आंजन — a. (नी f.) [अंजनस्येदं-अण्] Anointing or belonging to ointment. --नं 1 Ointment, especially for the eyes. --2 Fat. --नः N. of Māruti or Hanūmat; दाशरथिबलैरिवांजननीलनलपरिगतप्रांतैः K. 58.
आंजनेयः — [अंजनायाः अपत्यं ढक्] N. of Māruti.
आंजनिक्यं — [पुरोहितादिगण P. V. 1. 128] That which is used to prepare ointments.
आंजिनेयः — [अंजिन्यां भवः ढक्] A kind of insect, a kind of lizard.

m: आं-कृति m. N. of a prince v.l. for आ-कृति, q.v.

a: आंकुशिकः — [अंकश-ठक्] One who strikes with the goad.
आंक्षी — A musical instrument, a tabor.
आंडी — Ved. A testicle.
आंडीक — a. Bearing eggs.
आंडीर — a. [आंडमस्त्यस्य ईरच्] 1 Having many eggs. --2 Grown up, full-grown (as a bull.).

आंड — a. [अंडे भवः अण्] Born from an egg (as a bird). --डः An epithet of Hiraṇyagarbha or Brahmā. --डं 1 A multitude of eggs, brood. --2 Scrotum. --डौ (Ved.) The testicles. --Comp. --ज a. born from eggs. --(जः) a bird or a serpent. --(जं) the body of a bird.
आंत — a. (ती f.) [अंत-अण्] Final, terminal. --तं ind. Completely, to the end.
आंतरागारिक — a. Belonging to the duties of a store-keeper or chamberlain.
आंतराल — a. [अंतरालं वेत्ति अण्] One conversant with the inner nature.
आंतर — a. [अंतर् मध्ये भवः अण्] 1 Internal, secret, hidden; U. 6. 12; Māl. 1. 24. --2 Inmost, inward; U. 2. --रं Inmost nature. --Comp. --ज्ञ Knowing the hidden secret (of things &c.); Māl. 1. 8.
आंतरतम्यं, आंतर्यं — Nearest or closest relationship (as of letters).
आंतर्गणिक — a. (की f.) [अंतर्गणं भवः ठञ्] Included, comprised (as in a class, troop &c).
आंतर्गेहिक — a. (की f.) [अंतर्गेहं वेश्मनि भवः ठञ्] Being or produced inside a house.
आंतरि(री)क्ष — a. (क्षी f.) [ अंतरिक्षे भवः अण्] 1 Atmospherical, heavenly, celestial. --2 Produced in the atmosphere. --क्षं The firmament, the intermediate region between the earth and sky.
आंतिका — [अंतिकेव अण् टाप्] An elder sister.
आंत्र — a. (त्री f.) [अंत्र-अण्] Relating to the bowels. --त्रं Ved. Bowels, entrails.
आंत्रिक — a. (की f.) Visceral, being within or relating to the bowels.
आंत्यः — Ved. One who finishes.
